why: State cycle 3 (docs/v3/cycles/state-3.md). A page store's `useReset()` unsets every field (`router/controls/define.ts:699-710`), the view tab and the open record with the filters: a Clear filters on the chart's empty state wired to it turned `?q=zzz&flagged=true&view=chart` into `?` and landed on the table (P2 state-3.4, `.evidence/cycle-state-3/explore-reset.log`). `FilterSet`'s own `Reset all` unsets only its specs, through a census that is not exported, so an app that wants the same reset anywhere else (an empty state, a command) clears its filter fields one by one (`apps/playground/src/cycle/state-3/OrdersPage.tsx:45-51`). change: (1) The store's `useReset` takes an optional subset: `useReset({ only: [handle, …] })` returns a callback that unsets those fields in one navigate (replace) and leaves the rest; with no argument it unsets every field as today. (2) `FilterSet`'s `Reset all` and its sheet use that call with their specs' handles, so the two resets are one implementation. (3) `docs/define-controls.md` says that `useReset()` with no argument also unsets view and record fields, and shows `useReset({ only })` for a Clear filters outside the FilterSet, beside a table's or chart card's `empty.filtered`. (4) A URL field's `set(fallback)` unsets its key, as a range or multi set back to its default already does, so `ViewTabs` on its default leaves the URL; a `history: 'push'` field still pushes the entry (state-3.7).
